title: Repair the failing pipeline parity gate before financial releases
evidence: npm run pipeline:verify failed in the preceding review: runtime body differences and missing EnsuredPipelineSchemaGeneration/src/pipeline/schemaGeneration/catalogAssembly.ts; scripts/verify-pipeline-parity.mjs reads the stale target.
action: Reconcile package ownership and parity manifests without deleting meaningful verification.
criteria: Clean checkout pipeline:verify completes successfully.
CI verifies the actual versions of compute, capacity and shared financial models.

title: Prove consistent financial backups and cross-service recovery
evidence: Commercial entries, pricing, bindings, subscriptions and feedback live behind separate persistence/service boundaries; no cross-service financial restore proof was established.
action: Define recovery checkpoints and reconcile financial references after restore, including immutable evidence and provider event replay.
criteria: Restore a test backup and reconcile totals, source hashes and active versions.
Document recovery objective, rollback boundaries and treatment of external payments.

title: Preserve party, currency and valuation evidence from financial documents
evidence: Pipeline extraction/normalization exist; downstream pricing reads selected canonical financial keys while servicing records external evidence references. End-to-end party/money provenance is not established.
action: Define typed source facts for amounts, currency, unit, period, payer/payee candidates and document/table location; preserve conflicting facts for review.
criteria: Fixtures distinguish premium, TIV, limit, paid/incurred loss and commissions.
Every accepted financial input points to source evidence; ambiguous currency or party stays unresolved.

title: Implement tenant-scoped search for financial evidence
evidence: EnsuredPipelineStorageSearch/src/pipeline/storageSearch/service.ts returns {ok:true, received:payload}; no indexing is performed.
action: Index approved financial artifacts with tenant, submission, party and immutable revision metadata; support retrieval and retention.
criteria: A user retrieves the exact evidence for a posted financial item.
Cross-tenant search is denied; retries do not create duplicate artifact versions.

title: Stop combining different currencies in legacy board premium totals
evidence: EnsuredAPI/src/routes/underwritingSubmissions.ts:437-465 sums item.values.premium using Number and formats one total/average without currency partitioning. New issuedQuoteMetric separately uses currency buckets; this bug concerns the legacy board summary only.
action: Apply explicit financial provenance and currency grouping to the board summary; avoid shared-portfolio double counting.
criteria: USD 100 and EUR 100 never display as one 200 currency amount without a cited FX conversion.
Same-source duplicates are counted once and unavailable premiums are excluded rather than treated as observed zero.

title: Pin a common financial revision across workbench, pricing, quotes and servicing
evidence: Compute reads CanonicalSubmission.data; quotes freeze saved workbench sections; bindings freeze signing snapshots; commercial entries reference commercial revisions. These histories exist but no common financial dependency manifest was demonstrated.
action: Link approved financial revisions and their source hashes across these existing stores; invalidate dependent calculations on material corrections.
criteria: A currency/premium correction identifies all stale quotes and computations.
Restore/replay selects the same inputs without rewriting old quotes or posted entries.

title: Select exposure by the declared rating basis instead of always preferring TIV
evidence: compute/service.ts deriveExposure checks financials.tiv before revenue/payroll regardless of exposureBasis. Isolated source helper: TIV=1000000, revenue=100000, basis=revenue returns exposureBase=1000000 labeled revenue.
action: Resolve the configured/prior basis before choosing a canonical value; validate nested/flat mapping and compatible units.
criteria: Revenue fixture selects 100000, payroll selects payroll and TIV selects TIV.
Missing required basis defers modeling rather than silently substituting another measure.

title: Preserve unavailable model premium instead of persisting numeric zero
evidence: compute/assemble.ts mapToPersistence maps technicalPremium=null to premium="0". Isolated source reproduction confirms it. Some board evidence paths mask the flag, but the stored numeric value remains ambiguous. This is not a claim that legitimately negotiated zero-premium quotes are invalid.
action: Add explicit pricing availability to persistence/contracts and update consumers to distinguish unavailable from a legitimate zero.
criteria: Null model output remains unavailable in persistence and every pricing consumer.
A genuine approved zero premium remains representable with its own evidence.

title: Make model and pricing-version persistence atomic and concurrency safe
evidence: compute/service.ts:549 onward independently creates ModelRun, finds/creates Pricing, reads max version, creates PricingVersion, updates currentVersionNumber and writes RiskMetric; no encompassing transaction/lock is passed. Concurrent calls can select the same next version; later failure can leave a partial financial result.
action: Serialize version allocation per submission and commit all linked computation records together; define retry/idempotency semantics.
criteria: Concurrent runs produce unique monotonic versions with the correct current pointer.
Injected failures at every write leave no partial published pricing result; retries are safe.

title: Feed validated party loss experience into credibility-weighted pricing
evidence: compute/service.ts:372-375 fixes experienceLossCost=null and observedClaimCount=0. Credibility module implements Z=min(1,sqrt(n/nFull)); current outputs therefore remain prior driven.
action: Build versioned, tenant-scoped experience records with paid/incurred basis, exposure periods, valuation date and recoveries; map them to comparable model inputs.
criteria: No data gives Z=0; qualified fixtures give documented Z>0.
Gross/net losses, currency and valuation periods cannot be mixed silently.

title: Publish a financial model inventory and independent validation suite
evidence: Implemented methods include generic exposure-times-loss-rate, loss-ratio pricing, cat event-loss/Monte Carlo EP curves, parametric probability/payout, casualty ILF and credibility blending. deriveReturnAndRisk uses marginTarget as expectedReturn and loss/premium as riskScore. No cash-flow IRR is computed there.
action: Document each method, input units, gross/net basis, assumptions, confidence, calibration and intended consumers; establish independently reviewed known-answer cases.
criteria: Document model/version/inputs for every loss, premium, return and risk field.
Separate underwriting margin, investor yield and cash-flow IRR; label simplified cat/casualty inputs.

title: Use committed facility balances for underwriting capacity decisions
evidence: CapacityMatchService reads configured capacityByPeril; commercial/ledger.ts has exact BigInt-cent reservations/allocations/releases with limits. The stage does not read that authoritative commercial ledger.
action: Connect stage decisions to eligible facility/commitment balances and carry stable reservation IDs into binding.
criteria: Concurrent bind/allocation cannot exceed facility limits.
Release, expiry and declined quotes update available capacity exactly once.

title: Define and enforce unknown-capacity and currency policy
evidence: CapacityMatchService sets hasCapacity=true when riskCapacity is null and parses dealSize with Number without an explicit currency conversion contract. It emits an unconfigured flag, but transaction use of that flag needs a policy.
action: Keep unknown distinct from available; require reviewed capacity/currency evidence before increasing obligations.
criteria: Missing cap cannot authorize a binding financial commitment.
Currency mismatch and missing FX basis produce a clear referral or rejection.

title: Link existing bindings to authoritative pricing, capacity and party obligations
evidence: signing/binding.ts already supports immutable signed/manual binding with locks and hashes. It inserts snapshots and financial fields but does not invoke commercial capacity posting or create payer/payee receivables; no pricing-version FK is supplied.
action: Extend the existing bind operation with approved financial lineage, reservation consumption and durable obligation handoff, using an outbox/reconciliation approach for separate services.
criteria: One bind links its pricing decision or documented manual override, accepted terms and capacity reservation.
Retry/failure produces one bind and one financial obligation set with recoverable pending work.

title: Specify financial completeness and exception policy for all binding paths
evidence: binding.ts permits a missing quote when signatures are ready, and bindingFinancials may return null date/currency/value; manual admin binding exists. These may be intentional paths, so they are policy/verification gaps rather than assumed bugs.
action: Define permitted no-quote/manual cases and mandatory financial evidence for each; enforce approved rules server-side.
criteria: Approved exception cases require accountable reason and financial evidence.
Normal binding rejects missing required terms, stale source hashes and unapproved financial overrides.

title: Apply versioned eligibility checks to parties incurring financial obligations
evidence: KYC supplies manual verification/expiry; scrub.ts only returns address/domain signals. Commercial terms include free-text eligibility and approvals, but reviewed binding/commercial paths do not establish a central transaction-screening decision.
action: Record and enforce policy decisions for provider, recipient, intermediary, capital owner and beneficiary at each financial action.
criteria: Expired/revoked/unknown evidence causes the policy-defined block/referral.
A transaction retains evidence version, decision time and authorized exception; no heuristic is called sanctions clearance.

title: Verify beneficiary mandates and separate payment approval duties
evidence: Commercial entries retain posting organization/actor; those fields are not proof of beneficial ownership, payout destination or authorization to change bank details. No payout mandate model was established.
action: Define beneficiary verification, payout-account change controls and independent payment approval against each party role.
criteria: Changing beneficiary/payment details invalidates prior approval.
Negative tests reject unauthorized party changes and self-approved disbursements under the agreed policy.

title: Do not report pending commitments as funded or invested capital
evidence: InvestorDealsService.ts includes pending subscriptions and sums committedAmount into fundedAmount and totalInvested; deployedAmount is ignored. Reproduction: pending committed=100, deployed=0 produces fundedAmount=100,totalInvested=100,capitalAtRisk=100.
action: Separate committed, called, received, deployed and settled amounts; derive cash-funded metrics from reconciled evidence.
criteria: Pending fixture displays committed 100 and funded/deployed 0.
Cancelled, partially funded and reversed cases have correct distinct totals.

title: Exclude unowned opportunities from portfolio return and stop calling weighted yield IRR
evidence: InvestorDealsService.buildDashboardSummary weights every row by Math.max(1,investorCommittedAmount). Reproduction: owned 100 at 10% plus unowned opportunity at 90% changes blendedIrr from 10 to 10.792079%. No dated cash-flow IRR is computed.
action: Weight only eligible owned positions and use an accurate metric label; implement cash-flow IRR separately if required.
criteria: Adding/removing unowned deals never changes portfolio return.
Zero portfolio reports unavailable/zero per policy; IRR requires dated cash flows and solver validation.

title: Remove hardcoded financial totals from the live marketplace
evidence: EnsuredMarketplace/src/Pages/Marketplace/Marketplace.sections.tsx renders Global TVL: $4.2B; REVIEW.md acknowledges illustrative market signal/counts/grades.
action: Source aggregate financial indicators from reconciled data with currency, as-of and coverage, or label/remove demonstration values.
criteria: No fixture-derived TVL appears as live money.
Loading/unavailable states cannot be confused with zero or a verified balance.

title: Connect marketplace actions to authorized financial workflows
evidence: Marketplace.sections.tsx Allocate buttons have no handlers; REVIEW.md also identifies prospectus/risk-model and filtering gaps.
action: Wire allocations to the approved commitment workflow with financial preview, eligibility, capacity and idempotent confirmation.
criteria: Allocation displays party, currency, amount, fees and resulting commitment state.
Errors/retries do not duplicate commitments; documents show the exact reviewed version.

title: Add explicit payer/payee financial accounts and a reconciled party subledger
evidence: commercial_servicing_entries stores record_id, amount/currency and posting organization_id/actor_id, but no payer/payee/account sides. Capital models separately store balances and Fee.chargedToEntityType/Id. Current summaries are per contract/currency, not per-party receivable/payable statements.
action: Design canonical party/account identities and balanced append-only postings or an equivalently reconcilable subledger; map existing contractual events without treating the posting actor as debtor.
criteria: Insured/broker/MGA/cedent/reinsurer/retrocessionaire/SPV/investor/platform balances trace to contracts and source events.
Per-currency debits and credits reconcile; each party can obtain an authorized receivable/payable statement.

title: Define currency and minor-unit rules across all financial models
evidence: Deal, Tranche, CapitalCommitment, TrancheSubscription and Fee lack explicit currency fields in capital.models.ts; CollateralAccount has currency. Commercial money helpers and numeric(18,2) use two decimals while accepting a broad currency set.
action: Adopt explicit currency inheritance/snapshots, supported currency precision and controlled FX conversions; backfill without guessing.
criteria: Mixed-currency totals are prohibited without rate/source/time and reporting currency.
Supported zero/two/three-decimal currencies round correctly or are explicitly rejected; unknown legacy currency stays unresolved.

title: Implement funded-capital and collateral reconciliation beyond seeded records
evidence: CapitalCommitment, TrancheSubscription, CollateralAccount and CollateralMovement models exist. Reviewed API create/bulkCreate call sites for commitment/subscription/movement records occur in CapitalSeedService; a live external settlement path was not established.
action: Implement provider-confirmed calls, receipts, custody movements and immutable reconciliation with clear pending/failed/reversed states.
criteria: A sandbox commitment-to-funding journey updates one reconciled party position.
Duplicate/out-of-order events and unmatched statement items are handled without inventing cash.

title: Model gross-to-net premium, commissions, taxes and platform fees per party
evidence: RetrocessionTerms stores premium and commission as decimal strings without a commission-basis discriminator; Fee stores amount/rate and charged entity but no currency/payee/accrual lifecycle. No unified premium distribution calculation was established.
action: Define amount-versus-rate semantics and a versioned premium waterfall for the supported contracts; distinguish premium pass-through from platform revenue.
criteria: Worked example reconciles insured gross premium, intermediary commission, taxes, ceded/net premium and platform fee by currency.
Accrual, invoice, receipt, distribution and reversal remain distinct and auditable.

title: Calculate gross, ceded and retained claims using approved treaty terms
evidence: servicing.ts validates recorded claims against aggregate and ceded exposure caps; it does not calculate layer attachment/exhaustion, proportional share or reinstatement economics from gross loss. These inputs exist in RetrocessionTerms.
action: Define gross-loss input and calculate approved layer recoverables/retentions with explicit claim valuation and treaty basis.
criteria: Known-answer examples cover below attachment, within layer, exhausted layer and aggregate limits.
Gross, ceded, retained, paid and outstanding amounts reconcile without double-counting recoveries.

title: Support auditable payment reversals and financial adjustments
evidence: servicingKinds includes premium_due/premium_paid/claim/claim_reduction/recovery but no premium-payment or recovery reversal; database triggers prohibit updates/deletes. claim_reduction is not a cash reversal.
action: Add referenced immutable correction/reversal events with authorization and accounting effects.
criteria: Reverse a mistaken premium receipt/recovery without deleting history.
A repeated reversal cannot exceed or reverse the original movement twice; party balances and statements reconcile.

title: Implement party-specific recoveries and investor distribution waterfalls
evidence: servicingSummary returns contract-level premium/claim/recovery totals. Capital ownership/tranches exist, but no reviewed calculation connects approved claim recoveries to beneficiary distributions.
action: Apply versioned waterfall priorities, fees, ownership record dates and collateral release rules; separate approved, payable and paid.
criteria: Known-answer multi-party waterfall sums to distributable funds, including rounding residuals.
Retry, insufficient cash, disputed claims and reversed payments preserve correct balances.

title: Reject paid subscription simulation in production when Stripe is unconfigured
evidence: stripe.service.ts chooses simulation solely from missing STRIPE_SECRET_KEY. Isolated NODE_ENV=production fixture with a paid plan and arbitrary nonempty paymentMethodId returns simulated active subscription.
action: Require explicit nonproduction simulation mode; fail closed for paid production checkout with missing provider configuration.
criteria: Production missing key returns configuration error and persists no active paid subscription.
Local/test simulation remains explicit and marked; free plans retain intended behavior.

title: Restrict checkout plans to the authenticated participant eligibility
evidence: subscriptions.ts trusts body.planCode/body.role and does not compare selected plan with user role/eligibility. Reproduced mocked authenticated investor + {role:"admin"} yields active platform-operations subscription costing 0. This confirms subscription eligibility bypass, not admin privilege escalation.
action: Resolve permitted plans server-side and reject unauthorized free/admin plan selection.
criteria: Ordinary investor cannot select platform-operations through either role or planCode.
Role changes and permitted plan transitions are explicit and audited.

title: Prevent duplicate external subscriptions on concurrent checkout or retry
evidence: subscriptions.ts does findOne(active), then provider creation, then local Subscription.create without lock/idempotency. stripe.service.ts creates customer/product/subscription without an idempotency key; billing model has no unique external subscription constraint. Concurrent or incomplete retries can create multiple external obligations.
action: Persist a checkout operation before provider calls, use stable provider idempotency keys, reconcile uncertain results and resume incomplete payment instead of creating another.
criteria: Concurrent requests and timeout-after-provider-success yield one intended subscription/charge.
DB write failure can be reconciled to the existing provider subscription; incomplete checkout resumes safely.

title: Reconcile subscription lifecycle, invoices and usage into platform receivables
evidence: Reviewed billing routes implement plans/checkout; no Stripe webhook route was found under API routes. Subscription stores current status/period, not invoice/payment/credit event history.
action: Add verified event ingestion, lifecycle reconciliation, customer/organization entitlement rules and billable usage/invoice mapping.
criteria: Renewal, past due, cancellation, refunds and out-of-order events converge correctly.
Invoice totals and platform receivables reconcile to usage and actual provider payments.

title: Create a cross-party financial invariant and failure-injection suite
evidence: Existing ledger and participationAmount suites passed (2 tests). Six isolated source reproductions expose other defects. No end-to-end financial conservation, concurrency or provider settlement proof was run.
action: Create independent expected results for cross-party premium, capital, claims, fees and payouts; include decimal boundaries, currencies, concurrency and retry/reversal scenarios.
criteria: Each financial lifecycle conserves amounts by currency and party.
Failure injection at DB/provider boundaries proves no duplicate money or orphaned published financial state.

title: Maintain a finance model/coverage register and investigate untested risks
evidence: This audit is local code review and isolated execution with mocked persistence/providers; it cannot establish production balances, deployed configuration, legal acceptance or real settlement correctness.
action: Record models, ownership, formulas, authoritative writers, invariants, test evidence and unresolved risks; validate legacy balances and provider statements in staging with approved access.
criteria: Every financial field has an owner, unit, party scope, source and validation status.
Unverified risks remain investigation gaps until reproduced; release sign-off records unresolved limitations.
